title: Laredo to host candidate forums for District VIII race tonight and mayoral runoff Nov. 18
excerpt: Laredo voters get two chances to hear the candidates face to face before the December elections: a District VIII forum tonight, Nov. 12, and a mayoral forum Nov. 18, both at 6:30 p.m. in City Hall Council Chambers.
content:
The City of Laredo is hosting candidate forums for the two city races still on the ballot, giving voters a chance to hear from the candidates before the December elections, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The District VIII forum is tonight, Thursday, Nov. 12, and the mayoral forum is Tuesday, Nov. 18. Both forums begin at 6:30 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, the report said.

The mayoral runoff on Dec. 12 pits District VIII Councilwoman Alyssa Cigarroa against incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño. Cigarroa led the five-candidate field on Nov. 3 with 35.10% of the vote, followed by Treviño with 32.5%, according to KGNS.

The District VIII contest is a special election on Saturday, Dec. 5, to fill the council seat, according to a city resolution ordering the election. Early voting for that special election runs Nov. 23 through Dec. 1.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 11, 2026; KGNS, Nov. 4, 2026; City of Laredo Resolution No. 2026-R-205.

Update — November 12, 2026

The District VIII candidate forum is underway tonight at City Hall Council Chambers, and the City of Laredo is streaming it live on its Facebook page. The forum, which began at 6:30 p.m., covers the special election to fill the District VIII council seat on Saturday, Dec. 5. The mayoral runoff forum follows Tuesday, Nov. 18, at 6:30 p.m.

Source: City of Laredo, live video, Nov. 12, 2026.

Update — November 12, 2026 (evening)

The District 8 candidate forum has wrapped up. The City of Laredo says it successfully hosted the forum, giving residents a chance to hear directly from the candidates about their priorities and vision for the district. The forum featured the candidates who attended the city's mandatory candidate orientation.

The city also shared the key dates for the special election: early voting begins November 23; there is no voting November 26-27 for the Thanksgiving holiday; early voting ends December 1; and Election Day is Saturday, December 5.

Voters who missed the forum can watch a replay on the City of Laredo - Government Facebook page or the city's YouTube channel, Public Access Channel 1984. The mayoral runoff forum follows Tuesday, November 18, at 6:30 p.m. in City Hall Council Chambers.

Source: City of Laredo, November 12, 2026.
